claim: Captured waveform contains a 60 Hz-spaced harmonic ladder
required_evidence: Discrete peaks at integer multiples of 60 Hz in the post capture
uncertainty: FFT bin spacing = 2 Hz (0.5 s capture)
baseline_result: Baseline peak table also shows 6 peaks coincident with 60 Hz harmonics
control_result: No matched raw control waveforms available
injection_sensitivity: ladder detection power high for amp>=0.5
limitation: Native 2 Hz resolution; sub-bin estimates required for exact frequency

claim: Canonical Python log-cos result is reproducible in R
required_evidence: best k, delta chi2, A, phi within tolerance of summary.json
limitation: Deterministic part exact; shuffle null compared by distribution only

claim: Exact 2:3:4 frequency geometry occurs in the detected peaks
uncertainty: Exact by construction on integer harmonics
limitation: Both triplets lie on the 60 Hz ladder and share the 240 Hz peak; they are not statistically independent

claim: Log-cos modulation exceeds the canonical shuffle null
required_evidence: Observed scan-max delta chi2 above shuffle scan-max distribution
limitation: The shuffle null does not preserve all colored-noise or frequency-local correlations, so this exceedance is not by itself a source-attribution test

claim: Log-cos modulation under structured-noise and harmonic-ladder nulls
required_evidence: Compare the observed statistic with AR colored-noise and synthetic harmonic-ladder null distributions
observed_result: shuffle_canonical p=0.00498; block_perm_L8 p=0.363; stationary_bootstrap p=0.134; colored_noise_AR p=0.119; mains_harmonic p=0.259
limitation: These nulls test statistical compatibility with model classes; they do not identify the physical source of the measured waveform

claim: Harmonic ladder is an optically induced device state
required_evidence: Matched control separation: baseline/sham/disconnected/dark differ from post under the same acquisition conditions
observed_result: Not fully evaluable: baseline is peak-table only and several matched raw controls are absent
baseline_result: Baseline peak table contains 60 Hz-coincident frequencies
control_result: MISSING matched raw controls: sham, disconnected, terminated, dark, channel-swap, battery
limitation: The current archive does not establish a unique causal mechanism

claim: Structure persists beyond the recorded capture
required_evidence: Multiple sequential timestamped post captures showing decay
observed_result: Single 0.5 s canonical post waveform; within-capture stability only
limitation: No long-duration claim can be made from the canonical 0.5 s capture alone

claim: A resonator quality factor (Q_resonator = pi f tau) is established
required_evidence: Identified oscillation frequency + directly measured decay
observed_result: Not measured; no canonical ringdown time series
limitation: Q_ratio (2/3 geometry) must not be confused with a resonator Q

claim: Physical origin of the 60 Hz-spaced ladder
required_evidence: Matched controls that distinguish device-state dynamics from conducted, magnetic, environmental, and instrument coupling
observed_result: The frequency spacing is compatible with 60 Hz-related coupling, but frequency coincidence alone does not identify the source
baseline_result: Baseline peak table also contains 60 Hz-coincident frequencies
control_result: Existing observations are condition-dependent, but decisive matched raw controls are incomplete
limitation: Mains-related coupling remains an unexcluded alternative; the available data neither establish nor uniquely favor it as the origin
